description: This file contains implementation of GCD and related number theory functions for BIGNUMs in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library, including constant-time algorithms for cryptographic security.

methods.name: word_is_odd_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating if the given word is odd.

methods.name: maybe_rshift1_words
methods.description: Conditionally shifts words right by one based on mask.

methods.name: maybe_rshift1_words_carry
methods.description: Conditionally shifts words right by one with carry handling.

methods.name: maybe_add_words
methods.description: Conditionally adds words based on mask.

methods.name: bn_gcd_consttime
methods.description: Computes GCD of two BIGNUMs in constant time using Stein's algorithm.
